verses.1: The songs of praise for David! I rejoiced with these words: “The house of Jehovah will go forth.”
verses.2: Our feet stood at your gates, Jerusalem.
verses.3: Jerusalem is a city that is built together, as if it were one whole entity.
verses.4: There were then set up altars, as offerings to God, for the sake of Israel, so that they could worship God.
verses.5: For they will sit on judgment seats, just as David’s house had its seats.
verses.6: May peace be upon Jerusalem, my beloved one.
verses.7: May there be peace in your army, and may there be freedom in your palaces.
verses.8: So that my brothers and friends may speak peace to you.
verses.9: So that our God, Jehovah, may grant you good.
